data.long_meaning: A person who repeatedly calls out to Allah for help, guidance, or forgiveness. The name Duaoon is derived from the Arabic word 'dua' meaning 'prayer' or 'supplication'. It is a powerful reminder of the importance of turning to Allah in times of need. The name Duaoon carries the meaning “Call, Invocation” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Duaoon usually hope their child will grow to embody call, invocation and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Encourages a strong connection with Allah and a constant remembrance of Him.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Duaoon total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
